stepTitle: Two piloted satellites approach one another at a relative speed of $$0.250\,\text{m/s},$$ intending to dock. The first has a mass of $$4.00\times10**{3}\,\text{kg},$$ and the second a mass of $$7.50\times10**{3}\,\text{kg}.$$ If the two satellites collide elastically rather than dock, what is their final relative velocity (in $$\text{m/s})$$?
